# One-particle metrics g_B = 2c/(3 pi^2), g_KM = c/6

**Status:** `proved` — a complete structured proof.

**Area:** [Theorem A: exact recovery error of the free fermion](../status.md#area-theorem-a) · **Card type:** constant · **Knowledge-base id:** `const-gb`

## Statement

The Bures metric of the compression direction is g_B = 2c/(3 pi^2) and the Kubo-Mori metric g_KM = c/6, computed by three independent routes (modular frame, kernel identity, x-space Mellin). f2 = g_B/8. Caution: g_KM = c/6 is the metric of the direction, not the coefficient s2 of the relative entropy along the recovery curve (see conj-s2).
